Users & Roles

Permission tiers govern what each person can do; job titles are shown separately. Admin can change a tier — every change is written to the audit trail.

PersonJob titlePermission tierLeads

What each tier can do

Employees

The HR master record for every person — employing entity, continuous-service date, statutory registrations, compensation and contract. Admin-only; every view and change is audit-logged.

Confidential — PDPA. Salary and statutory-ID data. Restricted to Admin; each person can see only their own record via My Pay.
PersonTitleEntityContinuous serviceStatusMonthly

Payroll

Monthly payroll register — gross, statutory deductions (EPF · SOCSO · EIS · PCB) and net, with payslip generation. Admin-only.

Claims

Expense & allowance claims — itemised, capped, receipt-backed, submitted for approval. You see your own; Admin sees everyone's.

Offboarding

Leaver checklist — access revocation, asset-ownership transfer (Figma / Canva / repos), final pay, and handover-pack sign-off. Admin-only.

My Pay

Your own record — payslips, leave balance, statutory contributions and claims. Private to you.

Add reminder

Add to your calendar app

Subscribe to your ZAC Edge calendar from Apple Calendar, Google or Outlook. It is a live, read-only feed that refreshes automatically, so new appointments and reminders appear on your devices. Your Personal calendar stays private and is never shared with the team.

Anyone with this link can see your calendar — treat it like a password. Rotate it in Settings ▸ Security.
Apple Calendar
Google
Outlook
On your phone (read-only — easiest): the same link works everywhere. iPhone: Settings ▸ Calendar ▸ Accounts ▸ Add Subscribed Calendar, paste the URL. Android/Google: Add calendar ▸ From URL. It then syncs to your phone automatically.

Two-way (create & edit from your phone): connect ZAC Edge to your Microsoft 365 / Outlook account — ZAC posts events into your Outlook calendar, which your phone's built-in Calendar app already syncs natively. This is the recommended setup if you want to edit on the go.

Apply for leave

Attach medical certificate (MC)
Paid sick leave under EA s.60F requires an MC from a registered practitioner. Without an MC it may be recorded as unpaid.
Annual leave is a statutory entitlement under EA 1955 s.60E — no reason is required. Approver: AT. Approved leave auto-writes a blocker to your calendar and is deducted from your balance.
